### Function
「...~」*position marker of origin:* from / than / from the perspective of
### Antonym
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/than\|than]]
### Semanticization
*Appending a [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/(tse)\|tse]] glyph yields **[[]]***
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- compare to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/than\|than]], following the analogy by making the "origin point" the crossbow firing said arrow.
#### Sound
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/thi\|thi]] (because; cross-ref. to Japanese "kara" meaning both "from" and "because")
